observations: Photo 0 shows four retail boxes for 'SWITCH ON' brand digital kettles.
The boxes indicate a 1.7L capacity and a 3000W power rating.
The packaging features German text ('Digitaler Wasserkocher') and the Kaufland logo.
A 'Premium Edition' label and 'GS' safety mark are visible on the boxes.
The boxes show a kettle with an integrated LED temperature display on the body.
No images of the actual product outside the box or the power cord are provided.

claims.evidence: Actual boiling time depends on local voltage and water temperature, which cannot be verified from photos.

risks.risk: The heating element or the digital temperature display may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video of the kettle plugged in and boiling water.
